nitrate uptake in banana is a low-affinity, high-capacity process.

the uptake rate of nitrate in the banana seedlings was reduced in the soil of 100 percent nitrate treated with an increasing ratio of ammonium, while the nitrate affinity was increased with an increasing ratio.
the ammonium ratio had a significant effect on the Vmax and Km of banana seedlings, and that the affinity of nitrate uptake was reduced with the increasing of ammonium ratio.
